name: GAME_Init
note: One-time startup: CD drive and paths, DREAMS.DAT, the 0x172000 MEM stack, the 0x57800 stream, fonts hi640/480/320, sour.alp, dialog.drd, UI icons. Failures are fatal.

name: ANIM_ApplyPendingState
note: Commits +0x160 to +0x15c, looks up the clip in 0x4f7728, starts a blend; picks idle after one-shots.

name: RES_ReadFile

facts: str:can't find DAN file; str:%sdata/3dc/%s; call:00056908; call:00071318
note: Takes a free slot of 32 (stride 0x2d0) and loads a 3D object: its .DAN if any, the model via RES_Load, then its properties from the current DREAMS.DAT record.

name: ENT_LoadModel
facts: str:can't find DSN file; str:No 3di file; call:00056908; call:00051374; caller:00027d50
note: Loads one actor's model (DSN, DAN, .3DC, .3DI, anim set)

name: ENT_InstantiateFromObjet
note: Spawns an actor from a scene object definition.

name: SCENE_InitLevel
note: Scene start-up after loading: world state, per-level settings, player avatar and anims, module inits, camera.

name: SCENE_LoadLevel
note: Level loader when the pending-load flag is set.

name: SCENE_CheckExits
note: Checks up to 8 exit zones, loads the target scene; player death restart via Project0.

name: ENT_UpdateSwimming
note: Per-actor water update: swim state, splash, air refill, bubbles.

name: SPR_BlendChannel
note: Mixes one colour channel by alpha via the 32x32 product table.

name: SPR_BlendPixel
note: Blends two 565/555 pixels by the global alpha.

name: UI_DrawPyramidGauge
note: Draws the HUD pyramid gauge, replacing marker bytes 0xff/0xfe/0xfd with fill texels below each level.

name: TEXT_BlitGlyphFaded
note: Glyph blit with one alpha for the whole glyph.

name: DDAT_Load
note: Loads dreams.dat (0x25400 bytes) and unpacks the current record; fills an "EMPTY" default table when the file is missing.

name: DDAT_LoadRecord
note: Finds a named record among the 150 DREAMS.DAT entries (unless "EMPTY") and RLE_UnpackZeros it into 0x65b344; falls back to the previous name.

name: AI_DispatchSquadOrders
note: Squad order dispatcher.

name: MGM_SendMessage
note: Raises "Dreams Internal Error : unknown message type in MGM_SendMessage".

name: MGM_DispatchMessages
note: Raises "Dreams Internal Error : unknown message type in MGM_DispatchMessages".

name: CAM_CompCameraPos
note: Raises "Dreams Internal Error : unknown event in CAM_CompCameraPos".

name: PHYS_TickEntity
note: Per-entity physics tick by mode.

name: ENT_SpawnAttackObject
note: Spawns an attack object from the 16-slot pool.

name: ENT_ApplyAttackHit
note: Resolves an attack object's hit by type.

name: ENT_TickAttackObject
note: Per-tick update of an attack object.

name: FILE_ReadOrDie
note: read_, fatal "Read file Error" on failure.

name: SPR_LoadSet
note: General sprite-set loader into slot EDX: 512-byte palette, 0x1c00-byte table of 256 descriptors at end - 0x1c04, pixels 16-bit when the name has .ALP. Fonts (via 0x425c61) and sour.alp load through it.

name: SCENE_TickTriggers
note: Evaluates the 16 scene triggers each frame.

name: DSN_LoadHeader
note: Opens a DSN container: magic, map names and records.

name: DSN_LoadTextures
note: Streams the texture maps in 32 steps (type 3 palettes, type 4 slices)

name: STRM_Peek
note: Returns a pointer to N (EDX) contiguous buffered bytes without consuming them; copies wrapped bytes into the slack area; exits if even the slack is too small.

name: FSB_Load
note: Loads a "DREAMS FSB  " bank: 12-byte magic, count N, N sizes into a (pointer, size) table, then the blob. The meaning of FSB is unknown.

name: DAN_OpenArchive
facts: str:DANF; str:not enough memory in DAN_Load3DC
note: Opens a DANF animation pack: magic, 5-byte block, two u16-counted directories (11- and 13-byte entries), 0x96000 work buffer. Its error text says DAN_Load3DC, as does DAN_Read3DC's; neither is proven to be the function of that name.

name: DAN_Read3DC
note: Reads one type-1 compressed chunk (at most 0x96000 bytes) from the open DAN file and LZ_Unpacks it.

name: VFS_Open
note: Opens from disk with _uopen_; failing that (read-only modes), looks the name up in the mounted .BF directory and returns -(index+1), seeking the archive to the entry.

name: VFS_Read
note: Read for VFS handles: a negative handle reads from its archive entry (clamped to the entry size); otherwise read_. Fatal on error.

name: VFS_Seek
note: Seek (whence 0/1/2) for VFS handles: archive entries clamped to [0, size-1]; otherwise lseek_. Fatal on error.

name: VFS_AddArchiveEntries
note: Merges a batch of 0x11c-byte .BF directory entries into the global table (0x4a2f94, count 0x4a2f98): copy on first call, then replace same-name entries or grow.

name: BF_Mount
facts: str:UBIK; str:is not a valid file; call:00058740; call:000587c4; call:00058b8c
note: Mounts a UBIK .BF archive: 16-byte header, directory of 0x103-byte names + offset + size into 0x11c-byte records added to the VFS table.

name: SPR_LoadIconBanks
facts: str:magie.alp; str:Read Icone Error; call:00058740; call:000587c4; caller:0005a500
note: Loads the five ICONES.BF banks named at 0x49dacc (magie.alp ..., stride 13) through the VFS; same TABLE format as SPR_LoadSet.

name: UI_InitPyramidIcons
note: Looks up the pyramid gauge icons.

name: UI_InitIcons
note: Mounts data\icone\icones.bf, loads the icon banks, binds about 20 named icons (nothing, infosne, block, mcombat, joy_*) through ICON_FindByName.

name: UI_DrawHud
note: Per-frame in-game HUD draw.

name: MENJ_Dispatcher
note: Raises "Dreams Internal Error : unknown message type in MENJ_Dispatcher".

name: MENU_PlaceCornerIcons
note: Looks up UpLf/UpRg/DnLf/DnRg (NA and lit variants) and places them on a 2x2 grid scaled by the display factors.

name: MENU_DrawSaveSlots
note: Draws the 10-slot save/load list.

name: MENU_DrawObjectInfo
note: Object (category 2) detail panel of the pause menu: large icon from the 9-byte name table at 0x49db12 and three text lines; called from the object grid MENU_DrawObjectPage. Byte-identical code to MENU_DrawSpellInfo.

name: MENU_HandleObjectInput
note: Object-page input: moves the cursor 0x4a1004 over the grid (count 0x4a1008, built by MENU_BuildObjectList), plays menu sounds, stores the chosen object in 0x615410.

name: MENU_DrawObjectPage
note: Draws the object page of the pause menu: equipped-object icon, grid of up to 16 objects, then MENU_DrawObjectInfo.

name: MENU_InitGameMenu
note: Sets up the game menu: tab icons, labels, positions.

name: MENU_DrawHelpText
note: Three-line help text for entry n.

name: MENU_HandleGameMenuInput
note: Per-frame game-menu input.

name: MENU_DrawGameMenu
note: Draws the game menu.

name: MENU_DrawSpellInfo
note: Spell detail panel, called by the spell grid MENU_DrawSpellPage; byte-identical code to MENU_DrawObjectInfo.

name: MENU_HandleSpellInput
note: Spell tab input: 4x4 grid, assign to three quick slots.

name: DRD_Open
note: Opens DRDF (DIALOG.DRD): 16-byte header, entry offset table, entry buffer sized from the header; current entry = -1.

name: CD_PrepareLevel
facts: str:Please wait while loading; str:ListL%d.txt; call:000642f4
note: Level from the save record +0x1fc; asks for CD (level+1)>>1 if needed; with hard-disk caching copies the files listed in ListL<n>.txt / ListL0.txt to X:\CRYO\DREAMS\ behind "Please wait while loading ...".

name: CD_FindDrive
facts: str:1CD.ID; str:2CD.ID; str:your CDROM does not contain a CD of DREAMS
note: Tries drives Z down to C for X:\DATA\1CD.ID / 2CD.ID and stores the letter in 0x49ff2c; fatal error if none.

name: CD_CopyFileList
facts: str:error occurred while copying files to the hard; caller:00063e78
note: Reads a list file and copies each file to the hard disk in 0x8000-byte chunks; on failure deletes the copied .dsn/.dan/.hnm and LEVEL.ID, then a fatal error.

name: GAME_LoadSaveIcon
note: Looks the slot up in a 10-entry table and loads data\game\game%d.ico (0x2000 bytes) into 0x5d8b98; zeroes it on failure.

name: MDL_RelocNode
note: Adds the relocation delta to a node's pointers (+0x10..+0x18 links, +0x80..+0xa8), then relocates its primitive lists.

name: MDL_RelocNodeTree
note: Iterative depth-first walk (parent +0x10, child +0x14, sibling +0x18) calling MDL_RelocNode on each node.

name: MDL_LoadMaterials
note: Resolves a model's 44-byte material names through a refcounted texture cache; a miss loads <dir><name>.3DM with RES_Load and caches the page at +0x8014.

name: RES_Relocate
note: Registers a loaded resource (handle, size, type, list links at 0x661e3c) and turns its offsets into pointers by type; type 1 (model) also relocates the node tree and loads its .3DM materials.

name: RES_Load
note: Reads a resource file into the arena (capped at the free space - 0x14), advances the arena top, then RES_Relocate. Returns a handle (index << 16) or -1.

name: MDL_GetNodePosition
note: Copies a node's position (+0x1c) by handle (group<<16|node)

name: ANIM_EvalTrackLinear
note: Evaluates a linear-key track: slerp rotation keys (0x14) into +0x28, lerp position keys (0x10) into +0x1c.

name: ANIM_EvalTrackBlendLinear
note: Blends two linear-key tracks at frames fA and fB by a weight.

name: ANIM_EvalTrackBlendSpline
note: Two-track blend on spline-format keys (linear interpolation)

name: MATH_QuatSlerp
note: Fixed-point quaternion slerp, t 0..256, acos/sin tables.

name: SW_DrawObjectFaces
note: Default per-object face submitter.

name: REND_TransformClipVertices
note: Transforms vertices (+0x80, count +0x7c, stride 0x28) to camera space with clip outcodes.

name: REND_ProjectVertices
note: Transforms flagged vertices and projects them to screen.

note: Per-object render step.

note: Walks the object tree and draws each node.
